kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجلعد (form IVq)
# أَجْلَعِدُّ (ʔajlaʕiddu) /ʔad͡ʒ.la.ʕid.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
# أَجْلَعِدَّ (ʔajlaʕidda) /ʔad͡ʒ.la.ʕid.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
# أَجْلَعِدِّ (ʔajlaʕiddi) /ʔad͡ʒ.la.ʕid.di/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
